title: Founding Legal Counsel
posting_excerpt:
ow they get paid without the banks shutting us down. Today those questions are answered country by country, by outside counsel across several firms, with no one inside the company owning the design.

You will own that design. You will build the consent, data-transfer, entity, and contracting architecture that has to work in twenty countries rather than be rebuilt in each one, run the outside counsel network instead of being routed by it, and paper the commercial agreements on both sides of the business — the partners who collect the data and the customers who license it.

Securities and financing, export controls, national security, tax, and jurisdiction-specific regulatory matters will continue to sit with outside specialist counsel. You will own those relationships and translate that advice into action rather than being the specialist yourself.

You will be hands-on from day one, you will do most of the work yourself before you hire anyone — leveraging AI seamlessly and exhaustively — and you will build the legal infrastructure while the company grows from a founding team to thousands across multiple continents.

Your job is to help Build move quickly without taking risks we don't understand.



Key Responsibilities

• Own the legal path into new countries, including entities, EORs, contractors, partners, payments, and local regulatory requirements

• Build and own the global consent, privacy, data-transfer, retention, and data-provenance framework

• Draft and negotiate customer, partner, vendor, manufacturing, employment, consulting, and other commercial agreements

• Own international entity governance, maintenance, statutory obligations, intercompany arrangements, and compliance calendars

• Identify and manage regulatory risk across privacy, AI/data, foreign investment, payments, foreign ownership, and international operations

• Run diligence on Build's data rights and provenance for customers, regulators, investors, and acquirers

• Select and manage outside counsel globally, including scope, fees, quality, and translating specialist advice into action

• Partner with Operations, Data Scaling, Finance, Engineering, and Manufacturing to structure new markets, products, and operating models

• Make risk legible and give clear recommendations that help the business move quickly without taking risks it doesn't understand



You may be a good fit if you have (Must-have qualifications)

• JD and active bar admission in at least one US jurisdiction, with 6+ years of relevant experience including significant in-house time at a startup or rapidly growing technology company

• Owned legal work for a company operating across multiple countries — you have stood up operations in markets you had not worked in before, and dealt with what went wrong after launch

• Deep, practical data privacy experience: consent architecture, cross-border transfer, and the ability to work with a regime you have not read before and reach an answer that holds

• Strong commercial contracting experience — you have personally drafted and negotiated complex agreements on both the customer and partner/vendor side

• Have selected and managed outside counsel across multiple jurisdictions, including pushing back on scope and fees

• Comfortable being the entire department before you are the head of one, and comfortable giving a clear recommendation under time pressure with incomplete information

• Willing to be in San Francisco in person, and to get on a plane to Shenzhen, India, or any market we are opening when the answer is on the ground



Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice-to-have qualifications)

• Legal operations in China, India, Southeast Asia, LATAM, or Africa

• AI, data licensing, or another business where the product is data and provenance is the asset

• Contractor and worker classification at scale across multiple jurisdictions

• Marketplace, gig, or distributed-workforce platforms operating across countries

• Biometric,

title: Senior General Liability Attorney
location: Columbia, South Carolina; Columbia, South Carolina, United States
posting_excerpt:
ive team, we invite you to apply for our Senior General Liability Attorney position in our Columbia, South Carolina office.

This position may be structured at the Senior Attorney level, depending on experience. We welcome candidates with 8+ years of litigation experience, as well as more senior attorneys who are comfortable independently managing complex defense matters.

This position offers a flexible hybrid working arrangement.

The Position

This is an excellent opportunity for attorneys with litigation experience who are looking to grow their careers and take on increased responsibility in a busy and sophisticated defense litigation practice. The role focuses on defending clients in general liability, transportation, premises liability, catastrophic injury, construction-related injury, hospitality/recreation liability, products liability, trucking, auto defense, and other complex civil defense matters.

Attorneys earlier in their careers will have the opportunity to build on their litigation foundation through meaningful case work, mentorship, court appearances, depositions, motion practice, mediations, and direct client interaction. More senior candidates will have the opportunity to take on greater autonomy, manage complex matters, develop case strategy, work closely with clients and carriers, and gain hands-on trial experience.

The ideal candidate will have strong litigation experience, excellent analytical and writing skills, and the ability to manage cases from inception through resolution as part of a collaborative team.

Key Responsibilities

- Draft pleadings, motions, briefs, legal memoranda, discovery, and other legal documents

- Handle court appearances, depositions, mediations, and other litigation events

- Manage a litigation caseload as part of a collaborative team, with level of independence based on experience

- Develop case strategy, evaluate liability and damages, and work toward efficient resolution of matters

- Communicate with clients, carriers, experts, opposing counsel, and witnesses

- Prepare status reports, case evaluations, and other client-facing updates

- Collaborate with attorneys across offices and practice areas, contributing to a cohesive and supportive team environment

- For senior candidates, independently manage complex matters and help mentor more junior attorneys, as appropriate

Qualifications

- JD from an ABA-accredited law school

- Admitted to practice in South Carolina

- 8+ years of litigation experience required

- Defense litigation experience strongly preferred

- Experience with general liability, transportation, catastrophic injury, premises liability, construction-related injury, hospitality/recreation liability, products liability, trucking, auto defense, and/or other complex civil defense matters welcome

- Experience drafting discovery, pleadings, dispositive motions, and pretrial motions required

- Experience handling court appearances, depositions, mediations, and expert discovery preferred

- Experience cross-examining plaintiffs, fact witnesses, and/or experts preferred

- Trial or second-chair trial experience a plus

- Superior analytical, writing, and communication skills

- Strong organizational skills and ability to manage competing deadlines

- Ability to work independently while also contributing to a collaborative team environment

Why Join Wilson Elser?

- Meaningful Work: Handle sophisticated matters alongside experienced attorneys and partners

- Collaborative Culture: Work in a supportive team environment that values mentorship and professional development 

- Advancement: Gain opportunities for long-term growth within a nationally recognized firm

- Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy a flexible hybrid work arrangement that supports work-life balance

- Comprehensive Benefits: Competitive compensation, generous PTO, 401(k) match, and robust medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage

- Additional Perks: Access to corporate discount programs

This is a hybrid in-person role based in our Presidio office — one of the most beautiful locations in SF — 3–4+ days per week. We offer up to $2,000/month in post-tax rent subsidy for employees who live within 2 miles of our office and welcome candidates who would relocate.




WHAT YOU'LL DO
